description: Main source file for a Flutter mobile application that sets up the root widget, theme, and navigation between different screens: Explore, Plan, Recommendations, and Reviews.

classes.name: TravelGuideApp
classes.description: The root widget of the application that initializes the MaterialApp with theme and home widget.

classes.name: _HomeShell
classes.description: A stateful widget managing the main navigation shell of the app, with tab switching functionality.

classes.name: _HomeShellState
classes.description: Private state class for _HomeShell managing current tab index, screen list, and UI building.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point of the Flutter application, runs the TravelGuideApp widget.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for TravelGuideApp and _HomeShell, setting theme, navigation, and screens.

methods.name: _onTabSelected
methods.description: Updates the current index and UI when a navigation tab is selected.

methods.name: createState
methods.description: Creates the mutable state object for _HomeShell widget.
